test_title: PYST 35: RRB Group D - GA (Held On: 12 Dec, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: What was the theme for Ayurveda Day, 2025, as announced by the Ministry of Ayush?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Ayurveda for People & Planet**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Ministry of Ayush** has officially announced that the theme for the **10th Ayurveda Day**, to be celebrated in **2025**, is **"Ayurveda for People & Planet"**.
 
• This theme underscores the **holistic philosophy** of Ayurveda, which views **human health** as inseparable from the **health of the environment** and the ecosystem.
 
• **Ayurveda Day** is observed globally every year on the auspicious occasion of **Dhanwantari Jayanti** (also known as **Dhanteras**), honoring the **God of Medicine** in Hindu tradition.
 
• The **2025** celebration marks the **tenth edition** of this initiative, focusing on promoting **sustainable living** through Ayurvedic principles like **Ritucharya** (seasonal guidelines) and **Aahara** (dietary habits).
 
• The primary objective of the campaign is to **internationalize Ayurveda** and establish it as a robust, **evidence-based** system of medicine that addresses modern-day **lifestyle disorders** and **climate-related health challenges**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Origin of Ayurveda Day:** The **Government of India** decided to celebrate Ayurveda Day annually starting from the **year 2016**. The first-ever Ayurveda Day was held on **October 28, 2016**.
 
• **Lord Dhanwantari:** In Indian mythology, **Lord Dhanwantari** is considered an **avatar of Lord Vishnu** who emerged during the **Samudra Manthan** (churning of the ocean) carrying the pot of **Amrit** (nectar of immortality).
 
• **Ministry of Ayush:** Formed on **9th November 2014**, the Ministry of **Ayurveda, Yoga and Naturopathy, Unani, Siddha, and Homeopathy** is responsible for the education, research, and propagation of **traditional Indian medicine**.
 
• **Previous Themes:** The theme for **2024** was **"Ayurveda Innovations for Global Health"**, while the **2023** theme focused on **"Ayurveda for One Health"** (Ayurveda for everyone on every day).
 
• **Global Recognition:** Ayurveda is recognized as one of the oldest **healthcare systems** in the world. The **World Health Organization (WHO)** has established the **Global Centre for Traditional Medicine** in **Jamnagar, Gujarat**, to integrate traditional knowledge with **modern science**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs):** The theme **"Ayurveda for People & Planet"** aligns with several **United Nations SDGs**, specifically **Goal 3** (Good Health and Well-being) and **Goal 12** (Responsible Consumption and Production).
 
• **Digital Ayurveda:** The Ministry often utilizes platforms like the **"Ayurveda Day Portal"** to track **mass participation** and global events, which have previously seen participation from over **100 countries**.
 
• **Health Promotion:** Ayurveda emphasizes **Prakriti** (individual constitution) and **Panchakarma** (detoxification), which are gaining global popularity for **preventive healthcare**.
